blocks.en: (Student Administration Office, 11 Aug 2026)

◈ For the 80th Late-Term Degree Conferment Ceremony (graduation ceremony), the College of Engineering plans to add more commemorative features so that graduates and their families and friends can make more memories. These include photo zones and catering of drinks (coffee, etc.). The aim is to improve student welfare and to build pride as members of the Seoul National University College of Engineering.
blocks.ko: ◈ 제80회 후기 학위수여식 개최에 따라 졸업생 및 가족·지인들이 보다 많은 추억을 남길 수 있도록 포토존 운영 및 음료(커피등)케이터링 제공 등 기념적 요소들을 다양화하여 학생복지 향상을 도모하고 서울대학교 공과대학 구성원으로서의 긍지를 고취하고자 합니다.

blocks.en: Ⅰ Schedule
❑ Rental and return period ❍ 13 Aug 2026 (Thu) ~ 31 Aug 2026 (Mon), 10:00 ~ 17:00 (closed during the lunch break, 12:00~13:00)

※ On the day of the commencement ceremony (28 Aug), open 09:00~17:00 (open during the lunch break) ❑ Rental and return location ❍ Gown storage room (학위복 창고), 1st floor, Building 39 ❑ Important notes ❍ As a rule, the gown must be returned by 17:00 on the day after rental (if the return date is not kept, additional rentals (up to 3 times) are not allowed) ❍ What to bring: your own ID card for rental (resident registration card (주민등록증), driver's license, or passport is accepted; student ID card is not accepted) and a bag to carry the gown ❍ On 31 Aug (Mon), rentals are not available; only returns are accepted ❍ Rental and return by a proxy (another person acting for you) is allowed
blocks.ko: ※ 학위수여식 당일(8.28)은 09:00~17:00가능(점심시간 운영) ❑ 대여 및 반납 장소 ❍ 39동 1층 학위복 창고 ❑ 유의사항 ❍ 대여 후 익일 17:00까지 반납 원칙(반납일 미준수 시 추가 대여(최대3번) 불가) ❍ 준비물: 대여 시 본인 신분증(주민등록증, 운전면허증, 여권 가능, 학생증은 불가) 학위복 수령용 가방 ❍ 8.31.(월)은 대여 불가하며 반납만 가능 ❍ 대리인 대여 및 반납 가능

blocks.en: Ⅱ Who can rent
❑ Graduates receiving degrees at the 80th Summer Commencement of the College of Engineering
Ⅲ Gown rental and return procedure
❑ Rental procedure ❍ Apply online (https://student-eng.snu.ac.kr/)

- Check the rental list (desk in the storage room, 1st floor, Building 39) → Submit your ID card → Receive the gown ❍ For rental by a proxy: submit a completed letter of authorization for receipt (수령위임장, Attachment 2) and a copy of the graduate's (the person giving authorization) ID card, then leave the proxy's own ID card at the desk and rent the gown
blocks.ko: - 대여명부 확인(39동 1층 창고 데스크) → 신분증 제출 → 학위복 수령 ❍ 대리인 대여 시에는 작성 완료 된 수령위임장(붙임2)과 졸업생(위임인)의 신분 증 사본 제출 후, 대리인의 신분증을 맡기고 대여

blocks.en: ❑ Return procedure ❍ Return the gown to the gown storage room, 1st floor, Building 39, by 17:00 on the day after rental → The desk checks the rental list → Receive your ID card back
blocks.ko: ❑ 반납 절차 ❍ 대여 후 익일 17:00까지 39동 1층 학위복 창고에 학위복 반납 → 데스크 대여 명부 확인 → 신분증 수령

blocks.en: ❑ Inquiries: 탁애란 (Tak Ae-ran), Student Administration Office (학생행정실) (02-880-2277, subin219@snu.ac.kr)

english: The College of Engineering will rent out graduation gowns (학위복) to graduates receiving their degrees at the 80th Late-Term (August) Commencement, as described below. Eligible students should check the details.
A. Eligible: College of Engineering graduates receiving their degrees at the 80th Late-Term (August) Commencement

◎ Schedule: 13 Aug 2026 (Thu) ~ 31 Aug 2026 (Mon)
◎ How to apply: Online application (https://student-eng.snu.ac.kr/)
※ Open on weekdays 10:00~17:00 (closed during lunch, 12:00~13:00)
※ As a rule, return the gown by 17:00 on the day after you pick it up
※ Bring an ID card in your own name (student ID cards are not accepted)
※ Another person may pick up and return the gown for you
(Submit the letter of authorization for pickup (Attachment 2) and a copy of the authorizing person's ID card)
Graduation gown storage room next to the security office, 1st floor, Building 39
If rented on a Friday, return it on the following Monday
◎ Schedule: 28 Aug 2026 (Fri), on the day of the Commencement Ceremony
C. Gown rental and return procedure: see the guide in 'Attachment 1'
1) You need an ID card to rent a gown (Korean resident registration card, driver's license or passport are accepted; student ID cards are not accepted)
2) Please make sure to return your graduation gown
